When will you send the brushes for the concert series?
A. With the singer.
B. As soon as they are back from the printer.
C. While we were at the theater.

你什么时候寄送音乐会系列的画笔？
A. 和歌手一起。
B. 一旦它们从印刷厂回来就。
C. 当我们在剧院的时候。

choices: As soon as they are back from the printer.
